page_title: TOR 1-1 UDI | Torino v Udinese 23/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+2' Michael Fabbri shows a yellow card to Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) for his blatant foul.
90+1' Here is a change. Sandi Lovric is going off and Gabriele Cioffi gives the last tactical orders to Adam Masina (Udinese).
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' 1 - 1 What a goal! Ivan Ilic (Torino) receives an accurate pass and tries his luck with a long-range shot. He unleashes a superb strike that goes into the right post and behind the goalkeeper.
88' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 8:2.
86' That's the end of the game for Valentino Lazaro, who is replaced by Yann Karamoh (Torino).
86' Samuele Ricci (Torino) commits a foul and Michael Fabbri immediately signals a free kick.
84' None of the Torino players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
81' 0 - 1 What an excellent finish! Oier Zarraga (Udinese) latched on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and slotted the ball ino the middle of the net. Unstoppable shot!
78' Substitution. Lorenzo Lucca makes his way off the pitch and Florian Thauvin (Udinese) comes on as his replacement.
78' Gabriele Cioffi decides to make a substitution. Festy Ebosele will be replaced by Isaac Success (Udinese).
76' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
75' Substitution. Nemanja Radonjic (Torino) has come on for Nikola Vlasic.
73' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) is coming onto the pitch as Hassane Kamara cannot continue after picking up an injury.
71' Gabriele Cioffi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oier Zarraga (Udinese) replacing Lazar Samardzic.
70' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
69' Walace (Udinese) commits a rough foul. Michael Fabbri stops the game and makes a call.
69' A long pass, executed by Sandi Lovric (Udinese), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
67' Duvan Zapata (Torino) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the right post.
66' Torino take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
66' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The referee signals a corner kick to Torino.
64' Good movement by Sandi Lovric (Udinese), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
62' 11:6 – the total goal attempt statistics.
60' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
60' Substitution. Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) on for Brandon Soppy.
58' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

57' Duvan Zapata (Torino) and Ivan Ilic exchanged a few one-two short passes. Sometimes there's a need to switch play and change the tempo with some lofted passes to test the defence to see if it's alert.
56' Duvan Zapata (Torino) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
55' Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
54' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
53' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) has tested the patience of referee Michael Fabbri and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
51' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic intercepts the ball.
51' Torino players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
49' The game is interrupted as Duvan Zapata (Torino) is flagged offside.
49' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic comes off the line to clear the ball away.
48' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Hassane Kamara (Udinese) was quite harsh and Michael Fabbri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

47' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
45+1' Duvan Zapata (Torino) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out for a corner. Torino can continue in their attacking effort.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.

45' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Vanja Milinkovic-Savic to get hold of the ball.
43' Udinese win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
42' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) rips an amazing volley from deep inside the box that goes narrowly over the crossbar.
41' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) is about to take a corner kick.
41' Ivan Ilic (Torino) is able to continue to play.
40' Ivan Ilic (Torino) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
39' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Torino was in an offside position.
38' Ivan Ilic (Torino) will take the corner.
36' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
35' Torino keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.

31' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Antonio Sanabria (Torino) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Marco Silvestri pulls off a brilliant save.
29' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) is penalised for holding. Michael Fabbri signals a set piece.
26' Brandon Soppy (Torino) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
26' A player from Torino commits a rough challenge. Michael Fabbri blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
23' Ivan Ilic (Torino) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
23' Ivan Ilic (Torino) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!

23' It looks like Sandi Lovric (Udinese) saw red with that tackle. Michael Fabbri won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Torino earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
22' Torino can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
21' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Torino.
20' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Nikola Vlasic (Torino). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
19' Torino have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
16' A long pass finds Ivan Ilic (Torino), and he decides to test the keeper from long range. The shot flies towards the bottom left corner, but Marco Silvestri reacts well to make a good save.
16' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) received a pass and didn't think long what to do with it. He fired a powerful long-range shot which went painfully close to the bar.
15' Ivan Ilic (Torino) looks like he will send a long ball into the penalty box from the free kick and it is a good chance for one of his teammates who is good in the air to get on the scoresheet.

14' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Michael Fabbri blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Torino win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.

12' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) has a great chance! He climbs highest deep in the penalty box and strikes a powerful header towards the net. Next time he should aim better as his effort ends wide of the left post.
11' Torino control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
10' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
8' Duvan Zapata (Torino) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
7' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
6' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Marco Silvestri makes a great save.
5' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) outjumps his marker on the edge of the 6-yard box and heads the resulting corner well wide of the right post.
4' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Udinese will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

4' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Udinese.
3' Joao Ferreira (Udinese) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
3' Duvan Zapata (Torino) handles the ball inside the box.
2' An attempted cross from Duvan Zapata (Torino) is cleared.
1' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Udinese will take the kick-off.
Michael Fabbri is introduced as the referee for today's match.
